answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 67348 Country: pakistan Title: During fasting my penis started dripping with madhi drops due to some sexual thoughts. Is my fast ok or not? Question: During fasting my penis started dripping with madhi drops due to some sexual thoughts at that time I just hold (not rub) my penis in my hand (by tip of my 4 fingers not even by complete hand) for few seconds and I felt like my sperm is about to ejaculate so I quickly left my penis from my hand. But after 5 seconds I ejaculated. It was completely unintentional. Now I want to know if my fast is ok or not? Answer ID: 67348 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/726/D=11/1437) In the question mentioned above since the semen was discharged in the state of fasting hence your fast broke. Only its qaza is wajib, not kaffarah. أو ا س تمنيی بكفه فأنزل – قضی (الدر المختار مع الشامى 3/379 زكريا). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
